findings.quoted_text: 10.1 EXCEPT FOR EITHER PARTY'S VIOLATION OF THE CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS AND FOR EITHER PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE UNDER ANY CONTRACT, NEGLIGENCE, STRICT LIABILITY, OR OTHER LEGAL OR EQUITABLE THEORY FOR ANY AMOUNTS IN EXCESS IN THE AGGREGATE OF THE AMOUNT OF THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT.

findings.explanation: Your liability is capped at the total fees, but your indemnification obligations are excluded from that cap, exposing you to potentially unlimited financial risk from third-party claims.
findings.suggested_change: Except for either party's violation of confidentiality obligations, neither party shall be liable for any amounts in excess of the fees paid or payable under this agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am looking forward to getting started. Before I sign the agreement, I would like to propose a few small adjustments. Regarding the relevant clause ("10.1 EXCEPT FOR EITHER PARTY'S VIOLATION OF THE CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS AND FOR EITHER PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE UNDER ANY CONTRACT, NEGLIGENCE, STRICT LIABILITY, OR OTHER LEGAL OR EQUITABLE THEORY FOR ANY AMOUNTS IN EXCESS IN THE AGGREGATE OF THE AMOUNT OF THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT."), your liability is capped at the total fees, but your indemnification obligations are excluded from that cap, exposing you to potentially unlimited financial risk from third-party claims. To resolve this, please update the text as follows: Except for either party's violation of confidentiality obligations, neither party shall be liable for any amounts in excess of the fees paid or payable under this agreement. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards.
